title: Lost in the Middle (2024)
supports: Historical positional sensitivity on the paper’s tasks; not a benchmark of current coding agents.

title: Nx project and task graphs
supports: Project and target graphs have distinct responsibilities, separate from decisions and runtime authority.

title: TypeScript code navigation
supports: Definitions, references, type definitions and implementations are navigation capabilities, not just compiler diagnostics.

title: Gopls semantic navigation
supports: Definition/reference/implementation queries and documented build-configuration and dynamic-call limitations.

title: Git status
supports: Staged, working-tree and untracked state must be distinguished when describing source.

title: Git diff
supports: Tracked diffs describe selected comparisons, not automatically all workspace content.

title: Gopls implementation model
supports: Snapshots, saved files, unsaved overlays and build configuration are explicit state in the documented design.

title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
supports: Just-in-time context acquisition using lightweight identifiers is a vendor-described pattern, not a universal performance guarantee.

title: SQLite FTS5
supports: Local lexical full-text retrieval, including phrase and prefix queries; not automatically vector retrieval.

title: OWASP prompt injection
supports: Indirect prompt injection through external content and the need for independently enforced controls.
